title: Arthropod Molting · 節足動物の脱皮
sourceLabel: 既存教材をTOEFL形式へ変換 · 元の問1–9に対応
verificationNote: Editorial answers（編集・確認した解答）：本文と元教材の解説に基づき、記述問題を英語4択に変換しています。公式試験問題ではありません。

passages.text:
An arthropod wears much of its support system on the outside. Its cuticle protects the body, provides surfaces for muscle attachment, and limits water loss in many terrestrial species. Yet a hardened cuticle cannot expand continuously with the tissues inside it. Growth therefore requires repeated molts. This does not mean that the animal simply waits until its old covering becomes too tight and then tears it open. A molt is a coordinated cycle in which tissues, hormones, behavior, and environmental conditions must be aligned.

Before the visible escape, the epidermis separates from the old cuticle and begins producing a new one underneath. Parts of the old material may be broken down and recovered rather than discarded. Steroid hormones called ecdysteroids help regulate this developmental transition, while additional peptide signals organize the behavioral sequence that culminates in ecdysis—the actual shedding of the old covering. Calling every signal a “growth hormone” hides these different roles. A hormone can change gene expression or prepare tissues without directly supplying the mechanical force that opens the shell.

During ecdysis, contractions and changes in internal pressure help the animal split the old cuticle and withdraw from it. Depending on the species and habitat, taking in air or water can expand the body. The new cuticle is then stretched before it hardens, leaving room for later tissue growth. This physical expansion is important, but it is only one phase. The molt also includes preparation before shedding and recovery afterward; consequently, ecdysis and the entire molt cycle are related terms, not perfect synonyms.

The sequence carries a trade-off. A rigid cuticle is useful partly because it resists injury and supports movement, but immediately after shedding the replacement is soft. Movement may be limited, and exposure to predators or drying can be especially costly. Sheltering and timing can reduce risk, although no single strategy applies to all insects, spiders, and crustaceans. Molting also interacts with metamorphosis and reproduction in species-specific ways. The defensible generalization is therefore modest: periodic replacement permits growth under an external cuticle, while the details and risks depend on physiology, life stage, and environment.

questions.prompt: What is the main idea of the passage?

options.label: A
options.text: All arthropods use an identical hormone and an identical shelter during molting.

options.label: B
options.text: Molting is a coordinated sequence whose regulatory and mechanical stages should be distinguished.

options.label: C
options.text: Ecdysis occurs only after the replacement cuticle has fully hardened.

options.label: D
options.text: The old cuticle is always discarded without any material recovery.

questions.answer: Molting involves both regulation and mechanical action; neither alone explains the complete cycle. 正解：B。regulatory（調節に関する）段階とmechanical（力学的な）段階を区別するのが主旨です。Aは種の多様性を無視し、Cは硬化前の拡張と順序が逆。Dも古い物質が回収される場合を除いてしまいます。

questions.prompt: The word 'aligned' in paragraph 1 is closest in meaning to:

options.label: A
options.text: coordinated appropriately in time and function

options.label: B
options.text: measured with a straight ruler

options.label: C
options.text: replaced by an unrelated organ

options.label: D
options.text: made permanently rigid

questions.answer: Here, aligned means coordinated, not arranged along a straight line. 正解：A。組織・ホルモン・行動・環境条件が、適切な時期と働きの関係でそろう意味です。Bは字義的な直線の解釈、Cは器官の交換、Dのrigid（硬い・剛性のある）は外皮の性質であり、協調という文脈に合いません。

questions.prompt: Which sequence best matches the account of molting in paragraphs 2 and 3?

options.label: A
options.text: Ecdysis, hardening, production of a new cuticle, and expansion

options.label: B
options.text: Expansion, hardening, ecdysis, and production of a new cuticle

options.label: C
options.text: Production of a new cuticle, ecdysis, expansion, and hardening

options.label: D
options.text: Hardening, production of a new cuticle, expansion, and ecdysis

questions.answer: The replacement starts forming before escape and is stretched before it hardens. 正解：C。新しいcuticle（クチクラ：体表を覆う構造）の形成→ecdysis（古い覆いからの脱出）→拡張→硬化です。Aは形成を脱出後に置き、BとDは拡張や硬化を先に置くため、本文の順序を保てません。

questions.prompt: Why does the author object to calling every signal involved in molting a 'growth hormone'?

options.label: A
options.text: The term implies that old cuticle material can never be recovered.

options.label: B
options.text: The term suggests that all molting signals are produced outside the animal.

options.label: C
options.text: The term wrongly assumes that hormones supply nutrients to the new cuticle.

options.label: D
options.text: The term hides differences between developmental regulation, behavioral signaling, and mechanical force.

questions.answer: Ecdysteroids regulate a developmental transition, peptide signals organize behavior, and contractions or pressure supply force. 正解：D。発生の調節、行動の指令、実際の力は同じ働きではありません。peptide signalは「ペプチドによる情報伝達」。Aの物質回収、Bの体外での産生、Cの栄養供給は、著者が名称に反対する理由として示されていません。

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes air or water intake in the molt cycle?

options.label: A
options.text: It initiates every molt without any prior tissue changes or hormonal regulation.

options.label: B
options.text: It can expand the body and stretch the new cuticle, but preparation and recovery are also required.

options.label: C
options.text: It hardens the old cuticle so the animal can continue growing without shedding.

options.label: D
options.text: It performs the same role as every hormone and replaces muscular contractions.

questions.answer: Air or water intake can help physical expansion, but expansion is only one phase. 正解：B。体の拡張と硬化前の外皮の引き伸ばしを助けますが、先行する分離・形成と、その後の硬化・回復も必要です。Aは準備を省き、Cは古い外皮を脱ぐ必要性と矛盾。Dは制御信号と力学的過程を混同しています。

questions.prompt: How does the passage distinguish the molt cycle from ecdysis?

options.label: A
options.text: The molt cycle includes preparation and recovery, while ecdysis is the actual shedding stage.

options.label: B
options.text: The molt cycle is a synonym for ecdysis, and both refer only to physical expansion.

options.label: C
options.text: Ecdysis includes all hormonal preparation, while the molt cycle refers only to hardening.

options.label: D
options.text: Ecdysis occurs only in insects, while the molt cycle occurs only in crustaceans.

questions.answer: The molt cycle is the broader process; ecdysis is one stage within it. 正解：A。broader processは「より広い過程」。脱皮周期は準備から回復までを含み、ecdysisは古い外皮を実際に脱ぐ一段階です。Bは完全な同義語とし、Cは包含関係を逆転させています。Dの昆虫と甲殻類の区分は本文にありません。

questions.prompt: Which contrast illustrates the trade-off associated with replacing the cuticle?

options.label: A
options.text: A rigid cuticle prevents movement, whereas a soft replacement eliminates water loss.

options.label: B
options.text: A rigid cuticle allows continuous expansion, whereas a soft replacement prevents growth.

options.label: C
options.text: A rigid cuticle protects and supports the body, whereas a soft replacement leaves the animal temporarily vulnerable.

options.label: D
options.text: A rigid cuticle attracts predators, whereas a soft replacement always prevents attack.

questions.answer: Protection comes with a temporary cost during renewal. 正解：C。硬い外皮は外傷に抵抗して運動を支えますが、交換直後は柔らかく、捕食・乾燥・運動制限の危険があります。trade-offは「利益を得る一方で生じる代償」、vulnerableは「傷つきやすい」。A・Bは本文と逆で、Dの捕食に関する断定にも根拠がありません。

questions.prompt: Why should claims about sheltering and metamorphosis not be applied identically to all arthropods?

options.label: A
options.text: All arthropods live in the same habitat but differ only in body size.

options.label: B
options.text: Environmental conditions stop influencing an animal once ecdysis begins.

options.label: C
options.text: Molting has no relationship to either reproduction or developmental change.

options.label: D
options.text: Strategies and relationships vary with species, physiology, life stage, and environment.

questions.answer: A shared need to replace the cuticle does not imply identical strategies in every species. 正解：D。生理、生活段階、生息環境が異なり、隠れ方やmetamorphosis（変態：発生に伴う体の形の変化）との関係も種に依存します。Aは環境の多様性を否定し、Bは環境条件を切り捨て、Cは本文が述べる関係自体を否定しています。

questions.prompt: Which revision of 'Swelling causes molting' is best supported by the passage?

options.label: A
options.text: Swelling alone triggers the entire molt cycle in every arthropod; hormones act only after the replacement has hardened.

options.label: B
options.text: Swelling can be one mechanical component; tissue preparation, hormonal regulation, shedding, expansion, and recovery also contribute, with species differences.

options.label: C
options.text: Swelling explains the complete cycle in insects; differences among other arthropods concern only where they shelter afterward.

options.label: D
options.text: Swelling is unrelated to molting; hormones directly supply all the force required to open the old cuticle in every species.

questions.answer: The original claim mistakes one component for the complete process and overlooks species differences. 正解：B。componentは「構成要素」。膨張は力学的な一要素であり、事前の形成・ホルモン制御や、その後の硬化・回復も含めて説明する必要があります。AとCは膨張だけで説明し過ぎ、Dはその役割を否定したうえでホルモンを物理力と混同しています。
